meta.name: tugas golden
meta.note: Generated from eval/datasets/raw/*.txt by scripts/build_dataset.py; do not edit by hand. expected = the tool call(s) a correct agent must produce, matched as an ordered subsequence; only the args listed are scored. For no-tool tasks expected == [] and answer_any_of lists the accepted final answers (any-of, normalized).

tasks.prompt: Saya mau terbang dari Jakarta ke Makassar tanggal 12 Oktober 2026. Tolong carikan penerbangannya.
tasks.notes: Date already absolute — no parse needed.

tasks.prompt: Saldo saya Rp1.200.000. Habis Rp150.000 buat makan. Sekarang sisa berapa?
tasks.notes: Model must translate rupiah text into an arithmetic expression.

tasks.prompt: Cuaca di Samarinda minggu depan gimana?
tasks.notes: Requires resolving 'minggu depan' before calling weather. Only city is scored on cek_cuaca.

tasks.prompt: Besok tanggal berapa? Jawab format YYYY-MM-DD.
tasks.notes: Single-step relative date.

tasks.prompt: Meeting-ku lusa, tanggal berapa?
tasks.notes: 'lusa' is anchor +2 days, not +1; models collapse it to 'besok'.

tasks.prompt: Tiketnya tanggal 7/10. Itu 7 Oktober atau 10 Juli?
tasks.notes: DD/MM convention: 7/10 resolves to 2026-10-07, not MM/DD.

tasks.prompt: Saya beli 2 kodi telur, pecah 3 butir. Sisa berapa butir?
tasks.notes: kodi = 20. Accepted equivalent forms enumerated (any-of arg matching).

tasks.prompt: Sekarang jam 19.30 di Jakarta. Sapaannya apa — selamat pagi, siang, sore, atau malam?
tasks.notes: After maghrib the greeting is 'malam', not 'sore' (English 'evening' transfer). Time accepted as 19.30 or 19:30.

tasks.prompt: Kirim ke Jl. Pahlawan No. 12, RT 03/RW 05, Kel. Sungai Pinang Dalam, Kec. Samarinda Utara, Samarinda. Kota tujuannya apa?

args.teks: Jl. Pahlawan No. 12, RT 03/RW 05, Kel. Sungai Pinang Dalam, Kec. Samarinda Utara, Samarinda

tasks.notes: Reverse address order: street -> RT/RW -> kelurahan -> kecamatan -> kota. teks scored verbatim; the tool extracts the city.

tasks.prompt: Halo kak, kaos polos warna hitam ukuran L masih ready?
tasks.notes: Availability -> cek_stok. Extract barang+warna+ukuran from one casual line.

tasks.prompt: min, sepatu sneakers yang no 42 stoknya masih ada ga?
tasks.notes: "no 42" is a size, not a count; must not be read as jumlah.

tasks.prompt: tas ransel buat laptop, yang warna navy ready nggak kak?
tasks.notes: Variant (warna) availability.

tasks.prompt: kalau aku ambil 50 pcs gelas plastik, stoknya cukup nggak?
tasks.notes: Bulk quantity availability (jumlah arg).

tasks.prompt: hijab babydoll warna abu udah restock belum ya?
tasks.notes: Restock status is still a cek_stok call, not a date call.

tasks.prompt: tokonya buka jam berapa hari ini kak?
tasks.notes: Opening hours for today.

tasks.prompt: min, tutup jam berapa ya?
tasks.notes: No day given -> default today (no arg).

tasks.prompt: hari minggu buka nggak?
tasks.notes: Day-of-week hours; Sunday schedule may differ.

tasks.prompt: tanggal 25 Desember 2026 toko buka apa tutup?
tasks.notes: Multi-step: resolve the date, then look up hours. Reuses parse_tanggal.

tasks.prompt: yang cabang Samarinda buka sampai jam berapa?
tasks.notes: Branch-scoped hours (cabang arg).

tasks.prompt: lagi ada diskon apa aja nih kak?
tasks.notes: General active promos -> cek_diskon with no arg.

tasks.prompt: kemeja flanel ada diskon nggak?
tasks.notes: Product-specific discount.

tasks.prompt: kalau harga 180rb diskon 25%, aku bayar berapa kak?
tasks.notes: Reuses hitung; rupiah-text -> expression + percent math.

tasks.prompt: paket skincare-nya ada promo bundling nggak min?
tasks.notes: Bundle-promo lookup for a product.

tasks.prompt: kode voucher HEMAT50 masih bisa dipakai nggak?
tasks.notes: Voucher-code lookup (kode arg).

tasks.prompt: mau booking meja buat 4 orang besok malam ya
tasks.notes: Multi-step booking: resolve "besok" -> 2026-10-08, then check availability.

tasks.prompt: sewa room karaoke minggu depan jam 8 malam masih ada?
tasks.notes: Multi-step; "jam 8 malam" -> 20:00.

tasks.prompt: booking studio foto tanggal 12 Oktober 2026 jam 10 pagi bisa?
tasks.notes: Absolute date given -> no parse needed.

tasks.prompt: lapangan futsal malam ini jam 9 kosong ga?
tasks.notes: "malam ini" = anchor date; 9 malam -> 21:00. Implicit-date handling.

tasks.prompt: mau reservasi tempat buat acara ulang tahun 20 orang, minggu depan bisa?
tasks.notes: Party reservation, jumlah_orang arg, no time given (time optional).

tasks.prompt: Halo, apa kabar?
tasks.notes: A greeting needs no tool; calling one is the discipline failure.

tasks.prompt: Menurutmu, lebih enak kopi atau teh?
tasks.notes: Subjective; no tool can ground the answer.

tasks.prompt: hari ini penjualan berapa?
tasks.notes: Single-tool baseline for the sales-report tool.

tasks.prompt: laporan penjualan bulan ini gimana?
tasks.notes: Month-to-date sales.

tasks.prompt: bulan lalu kita jualan berapa?
tasks.notes: Previous month; distinct period label.

tasks.prompt: bandingin dong penjualan hari ini, bulan ini, dan bulan lalu
tasks.notes: MULTI-TOOL: one report call per requested period, in order.

tasks.prompt: penjualan tanggal 5 Oktober 2026 berapa?
tasks.notes: MULTI-TOOL: resolve the absolute date, then query that day.

tasks.prompt: pendapatan hari ini udah masuk berapa?
tasks.notes: Revenue today.

tasks.prompt: total pendapatan bulan ini?
tasks.notes: Revenue MTD.

tasks.prompt: pendapatan bulan lalu berapa ya?
tasks.notes: Revenue previous month.

tasks.prompt: pendapatan bulan ini naik berapa persen dibanding bulan lalu?
tasks.notes: MULTI-TOOL: two revenue calls + hitung for the growth percentage.

tasks.prompt: pendapatan cabang Samarinda bulan ini berapa?
tasks.notes: Branch-scoped revenue (cabang arg).

tasks.prompt: hari ini dapet berapa leads?
tasks.notes: Lead count today.

tasks.prompt: total leads bulan ini berapa?
tasks.notes: Lead count MTD.

tasks.prompt: leads bulan lalu dapet berapa?
tasks.notes: Lead count previous month.

tasks.prompt: bandingin leads hari ini, bulan ini, sama bulan lalu dong
tasks.notes: MULTI-TOOL: one leads call per period.

tasks.prompt: leads dari Instagram bulan ini ada berapa?
tasks.notes: Leads filtered by source (sumber arg).

tasks.prompt: dari semua leads bulan ini, 96 yang closing. konversinya berapa persen?
tasks.notes: The total is not in the prompt: fetch it before computing the rate.

tasks.prompt: produk terlaris bulan ini apa?
tasks.notes: Sales tool with the metrik switch.

tasks.prompt: target pendapatan bulan ini 100jt, udah tercapai berapa persen?
tasks.notes: MULTI-TOOL: revenue call + hitung vs target.

tasks.prompt: modal bulan ini 30jt. laba kotor berapa?
tasks.notes: Revenue is not in the prompt: fetch it, then subtract the stated cost.

tasks.prompt: tren penjualan 2 bulan terakhir gimana?
tasks.notes: MULTI-TOOL: two sales calls for the trend. (Period vocab has no "2 bulan lalu".)
